newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-FOREST RELEGATED, TITLE ON HOLD FOR MAN UTD.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-FOREST RELEGATED, TITLE ON HOLD FOR MAN UTD.

text.p: Nottingham Forest were relegated from the English premier league on Saturday after drawing 1-1 at home with Wimbledon -- but Manchester United's title celebrations were put on hold after they could only draw 2-2 at Leicester.
Eight teams are still in danger of relegation after a dramatic day of basement action.

A last-minute penalty by Fabrizio Ravanelli gave Middlesbrough a 3-2 home win over Aston Villa and West Ham thrashed Sheffield Wednesday 5-1. Southampton beat Blackburn 2-0 and Sunderland beat Everton 3-0 to drag both losers back into danger.
Coventry, who lost 2-1 at home to Derby, currently fill the last relegation place.
The battle for the runners-up spot is also going to the wire after fourth-placed Newcastle won 1-0 at second-placed Arsenal. Liverpool, third, play Tottenham later on Saturday.
Chelsea and Leeds drew 0-0 in the day's other game while Hereford were relegated from the Football League after drawing 1-1 at home with Brighton.
